## Games

### Ludwigsburg Defeats Bonn 84:68 in BBL Action

*Played Saturday, 24 October 2026*

The MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg secured a 84:68 victory over the Telekom Baskets Bonn in their easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga match on October 24. Bonn's Jeff Garrett led the scoring with 13 points, followed by Alijah Comithier and Joel Aminu with 11 points each. Ludwigsburg's Ishmael Leggett topped the scoring for his team with 18 points. The game was marked by a strong defensive performance from Ludwigsburg, who held Bonn to 39.3% of their field goal attempts and 25% of their three-point attempts. Bonn struggled to capitalize on their good defensive work, and despite a strong start, they were unable to overcome Ludwigsburg's offense. The loss marks Bonn's third defeat of the season, while Ludwigsburg improves to 4-2.

### Trier edges Vechta in high-scoring BBL matchup

*Played Saturday, 24 October 2026*

The VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier secured their fifth win of the season with a 97-88 victory over RASTA Vechta in the easyCredit BBL. Eli Brooks led the way for Trier with 22 points, including five three-pointers, and six assists. Brooks' performance was instrumental in the decisive phase of the game, where Trier's three-point shooting proved to be the difference. RASTA Vechta, who were playing with a new lineup due to injuries, struggled to contain Trier's offense and ultimately fell short. Armaan Franklin led Vechta with 23 points, while Matt Lewis added 14 points, seven rebounds, and four assists. The game was closely contested throughout, with both teams trading baskets and neither able to gain a significant advantage until the final quarter. In the end, Trier's experience and depth proved to be too much for Vechta, who remain at the bottom of the table.

## Around the League

### Phoenix Hagen to face Braunschweig in upcoming match

Phoenix Hagen will face Braunschweig in an upcoming match on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 15:00 hours. This is a rematch of a 2004 match between the two teams, which Braunschweig won 84-78. Braunschweig's head coach, Liviu Calin, is a 73-year-old former Romanian national team coach who is known for his innovative approach to the game. Calin has been with Braunschweig since 2004 and has a reputation for developing young talent. The match will be the first of two home games for Phoenix Hagen, who will also face Vechta on October 30, 2026.
